profile.summaryJa: サムエル記下8:2は、ダビデがモアブを打ち、モアブ人を服属させたと記します。この書での用例は民族・政治共同体を指し、族祖モアブ個人ではありません。
profile.identityNoteJa: 地理名・民族名・政治共同体を個人モアブの生涯としてまとめない。

primaryWitnesses.textualBasisJa: He defeated Moab, and measured them with the line, making them to lie down on the ground; and he measured two lines to put to death, and one full line to keep alive. The Moabites became servants to David, and brought tribute.
of Syria, of Moab, of the children of Ammon, of the Philistines, of Amalek, and of the plunder of Hadadezer, son of Rehob, king of Zobah.

Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, the son of a valiant man of Kabzeel, who had done mighty deeds, killed the two sons of Ariel of Moab. He also went down and killed a lion in the middle of a pit in a time of snow.

occurrenceChecks.reasonJa: ダビデが打ち、服属させたモアブの人々・政治共同体。
貢納をもたらす諸集団の一つとしてのモアブ。
「モアブの二人の子ら」という表現で、個人の祖先でなく出自を示す集団名。
